title: 2002 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: Let \(v,\) \(w,\) \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z\) be the degree measures of the five angles of a pentagon. Suppose \(v\lt w\lt x\lt y\lt z\) and \(v,\) \(w,\) \(x,\) \(y,\) \(z\) form an arithmetic sequence. Find the value of \(x.\)

solutions.text:
The five interior angles sum to \(540^\circ.\) Writing the sequence as \(x-2d,\) \(x-d,\) \(x,\) \(x+d,\) \(x+2d,\) the sum is \(5x=540,\) so \(x=108.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
